sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rs)==0 and max(rs)==0: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
before=sig(current_frame)
res=action(['SPACE'])
after=sig(current_frame)
print("board_changed:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
print("done/level:",last_action_result.get('done'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
for c in sorted(set(list(before)+list(after))):
    if before.get(c)!=after.get(c):
        print("CHANGED",c,"\n  before:",before.get(c),"\n  after :",after.get(c))
print("unchanged colors:",[c for c in before if before.get(c)==after.get(c)])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
